pin_diff.note: Functionally identical NC pin (N/C vs NC).

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 30% higher on TLV70033DDCR (TLV70033DDCR: 235.9 °C/W p.5 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 181.9 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: TLV70033DDCR requires Vin,min >= 2 V (p.5) vs 1.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: TLV70033DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because θJA worsens 30% (thermal derating verification required); Vin,min floor rises 0.5 V. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 60.2 °C on TLV70033DDCR (θJA 235.9 °C/W) vs 46.4 °C on TPS7A0233PDBVR (θJA 181.9 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1240x ratio (31 µA (p.6) vs 0.025 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: TLV70033DDCR "VEN Must Never Exceed VIN + 0.3 V (Sequencing Trap vs TPS7A02/TLV755P)" (p.5) and TPS7A0233PDBVR "Strict 22 uF Maximum Output Capacitance Limit for Loop Stability" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose TLV70033DDCR when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 175 mV dropout; choose TPS7A0233PDBVR when battery sleep budget demands 0.025 µA Iq or lower package θJA (181.9 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.4 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
